title: Relative Transitions, Not Absolute Destinations: A Transfer-and-Ground Framework for Target-Trajectory-Free Human Mobility Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.02033v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Individual mobility trajectories support urban analysis and location-based services, yet most trajectory generators require observations from their deployment city. This assumption excludes precisely the cities where trajectories are unavailable even though points of interest (POIs) and their attributes can be obtained from public maps. We study target-trajectory-free generation: learning from POIs and trajectories in source cities while utilizing only POI coordinates and categories in a target city, with no target trajectory or trajectory-derived statistic available for training, model selection, or generation. Existing trajectory generators typically predict absolute destinations, entangling reusable movement behavior with city-specific POI identities and spatial layouts. translated_title: 相对转移而非绝对目的地：面向无目标轨迹人类移动生成的迁移与落地框架
translated_abstract: 个体移动轨迹支撑着城市分析与基于位置的服务，然而大多数轨迹生成器都需要来自其部署城市的观测数据。这一假设恰恰排除了那些轨迹不可得的城市，尽管兴趣点（POI）及其属性可以从公共地图获取。我们研究无目标轨迹生成问题：从源城市的POI和轨迹中学习，同时仅利用目标城市的POI坐标和类别，在训练、模型选择或生成过程中不使用任何目标轨迹或由轨迹衍生的统计量。现有轨迹生成器通常预测绝对目的地，将可复用的移动行为与城市特定的POI身份和空间布局纠缠在一起。我们的核心洞察是用上下文条件下的相对转移取代这种与特定城市绑定的输出。我们提出Nomad，一个迁移与落地（transfer-and-ground）框架，它将……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Nomad框架，用上下文条件下的相对转移取代绝对目的地预测，从而仅凭源城市轨迹与目标城市POI信息即可完成无目标轨迹的跨城市人类移动生成。
en_tdlr: Proposes Nomad, a transfer-and-ground framework that replaces absolute destination prediction with context-conditioned relative transitions, enabling human mobility generation in target cities using only POI data without any target trajectories.
